weather_report:
In Boston today, the air carries a light warmth under a largely gentle sun, cloaked in a quilt of cottony clouds that resemble scattered whispers across an azure expanse. As you stroll through the streets adorned with the echoes of history, you'll find the temperature inviting you to shed any heavy layers but perhaps retain a light sweater for those moments when the breeze softly brushes against your skin. The forecast has offered a promise of continued clarity into the evening, a pleasant backdrop for conversations and laughter on patio gatherings that stretch into the twilight hours.

With a high nearing the delightful warmth of 79 degrees, this afternoon serves as a perfect stage for everyday adventures. Consider a leisurely wander through the lush green spaces of the Boston Common or a quiet moment with a book on a nearby bench, with the whispers of the city around you. As twilight approaches, the soft clarity of a moonlit evening invites a stroll along the waterfront, where the stars begin to dimly twinkle in reply to your quiet musings. Layers will serve you well as day turns to night, but for now, relish the simple, unadorned pleasure of a mild summer day in Boston, where the ordinary proves itself exquisite in its subtlety.
